notes: Version 3.1 aligns the statements imported from Q14 with its current contract. The self-adjointness of the projective endomorphism is now an explicit hypothesis, [H-SA]: Q14 states it only inside its hypothesis that the endomorphism is negative semi-definite, and it is not inherited from PRS, whose compression remainder equals Q14's endomorphism only under a symbol identity no source states. The non-negativity of the generation levels, and the bound |u| <= 1/2 drawn from it, now hold under [H-SA] and [H-Res], and [H-Res] states what it presupposes, an extension of the endomorphism acting non-trivially on the generation factor, on which Q14's endomorphism acts trivially; the algebraic level ordering is unchanged. The conditions of Q14's Theorem C are stated in full and those of its Proposition 4.5 on matter content and selection are added, and the continuum hypotheses inherited by the connection are named. The Q14 bibliography note is aligned with the programme's, and the bibliography carries the entry updates committed since version 3.0.1 (concept DOIs of LC-O1 and LC-O3, refreshed uncited entries, titles of O6 2.0, O19 1.3, O22 1.19 and O32 2.0).
